concerns.text: T002 implements `is_rare AND is_semantically_distinct` but spec FR-012 defines rare only as '≤5 occurrences.' Two different 'rare' populations break reproducibility. Update spec or remove semantic gate from task.
T006 grid search is over (α, β, λ) jointly (2,673 combos) but spec FR-001 says grid search explores only λ ∈ {0.1,...,9.9}. Spec does not authorize joint optimization. Clarify parameter search space.
T007 uses rare-event threshold '< 50' but spec FR-009 and SC-006 both state '< 30'. Contradictory thresholds; pick one and update all three artifacts consistently.

T007 identifies rare events as `is_rare AND is_semantically_distinct` but spec FR-012 defines rarity only by frequency (≤5). Semantic distinctness is not a spec requirement. Either add it to spec as formal FR or remove from task.

T001 requires 'code/requirements.txt' but does not specify exact version pinning (e.g., 'numpy==1.26.0' vs 'numpy>=1.26'). Constitution demands reproducibility via pinned versions. Clarify pinning strategy in task.

T007 records 'CPU cycles (`psutil.Process().cpu_times().user`)' which measures wall-clock CPU time in seconds, not cycle counts. psutil does not measure CPU cycles. Either update spec to ask for CPU time, or update task to use a cycle profiler (PAPI/perf).

T005 creates validation set of 50 queries but does not specify age stratification. If validation set lacks >14-day events, grid search may optimize (α,β,λ) on a distribution mismatched to long-term evaluation, yielding suboptimal hyperparameters. Clarify whether validation set must include >14-day events.

Plan says 'cluster event embeddings by event label' (per-label clustering) but T002 implements global k-means (k=10). Clarify clustering strategy: per-event-label or global? Update plan or task to match.
T009 is labeled '[P2]' but implements Phase 5 (reporting). Should be '[P3]' to match phase structure. Relabel or confirm intentional phase numbering difference.

T007 uses flag message 'Insufficient rare-event data (n < 50): analysis skipped' but spec SC-006 specifies 'Insufficient rare-event data: analysis skipped' (no threshold in message). Align message text exactly.
